changelog:
Choose how much the player buffers, and reset or tune your settings in one tap.

WHAT CHANGED

- Settings, Playback has a new Buffering choice: Low latency, Balanced or Stable connection. Balanced is how the app has always played. Stable connection waits a few seconds longer before starting and drops less on a shaky connection. Low latency starts sooner.
- Your buffering choice stays in force for the whole time a channel plays, including when the player has to switch decoders.
- Settings, Backup and Restore has Reset to defaults, which returns every setting to its default but keeps your sources, their passwords and your metadata key.
- It also has Optimise for this device, which sets the player up to suit your phone, with a smaller buffer on phones with less memory.
- Both ask you to confirm first.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- If you never change the buffering setting, playback is exactly as before.

NOT YET

- The app does not yet raise the buffer by itself after a stream stalls several times.
